title: Parse Live Telemetry
story: The ground station needs the temperature from a comma-separated telemetry message.
lesson: Use .split(',') to separate fields. A try/except can turn malformed numeric text into a safe None result.
objective: Return the float value from a TEMP= field. Return None if TEMP is missing or invalid.
hint: Loop over packet.split(','). Check part.startswith('TEMP='). Convert part[5:] to float inside try/except ValueError.
